en: Pinned, Projects and Recent default to collapsed when no preference is saved. Each section remembers whether you last expanded or collapsed it and restores that state when Prism reopens.
Right-click a project heading to edit its display name, alongside the existing pencil button.
Removed the duplicate Shared Capabilities entry from the left sidebar while retaining the right-hand entry. Sidebar utility labels and icons are smaller, with comfortable click targets.
zh: “置顶、项目、最近”在没有保存偏好时默认折叠；展开或收起后记住各分区状态，下次打开棱镜恢复上次的使用习惯。
在项目名称上点击右键即可编辑显示名称，同时保留原有铅笔按钮。
移除左侧重复的“共享能力”入口，保留右侧入口；缩小侧栏底部辅助操作的文字和图标，同时保留足够的点击范围。
